name: Anima Azraelis VI Sei
original_name: アニマ＝アズラリエスVI世
source:
A young Shinigami-girl who loves sweets. She came from the "Demon World" to reap human souls and is accompanied by her loyal servant, Dracolius.

[Spoiler]Sickness: 

Coprolalia: Sexual arousal caused by saying and hearing obscene words. 

After losing both parents and inheriting a fortune, she lost the warmth of loved ones and any need to strive for anything.

Being so young, she can start over as many times as she wants. Now she can live both supported by her new friends and for the sake of helping them in return.[/spoiler]

[Based on the in-game profile]

[spoiler]Her real name is Hashiba Mikio (羽柴 美希緒). Himea calls her Mikki (ミッキー).

Draco is actually a stuffed toy and a memento from her now deceased mother. She does ventriloquism to make it look like he can actually speak.[/spoiler]
